summary: Tested the Ask Owen orientation answer, the theme pill on /pricing mobile, the demo tour (personal link, guided tour, mobile), the new site-wide tracking (events.batch/people/person), the /admin/activity page and the /admin/contacts email chip. Re-tested the Brand Vault through the API and the UI (owner, contractor, revoke, export, rename). The Stripe charge.refunded handler was code-reviewed only, because live signed events can't be sent from preview. Backend: 31/31 pytest pass after one test-ordering fix in test_brand_vault.py (a test-data dependency, not an app bug). Frontend: every requested flow passed. Only 1 LLM ask was used (via the API: the 'I'm new to winemaking, how do I check my pH?' question got a real LLM answer, not the welcome). The rod-patina-wines contact was never used.

minor.issue: The first-visit alert has a race. It counts existing rows for the slug before inserting, so two batches arriving together could both send the alert email. The client-supplied 'at' timestamp is capped at now but can be backdated.

The server stores the typed question text in user_events ('asked Owen: <question>') with session_id='server'. This works against the 'typed values never recorded' rule (intentional, but should be documented). Because the session_id is 'server', it shows in /admin/activity as its own 'Visit' instead of inside the visitor's session.
Invited prospects have no 30-day window, but members and anonymous are limited to 30 days. events.person is limited to 400 rows (DESC), so older visits are silently cut off.

Code review only. The logic is correct: it looks up the checkout session by payment_intent, only acts when metadata.credit_pack==='true', uses target=floor(credits*amount_refunded/amount) minus already-reversed (credit_refunds PK charge_id, upsert), and clamps with GREATEST(…,0) on signed INT columns. Gaps: (1) the read-then-update is not atomic, so two concurrent redeliveries of the same event could double-reverse; there is no event.id dedupe. (2) Errors are caught and the handler still returns 200, so Stripe won't retry after a transient DB failure. (3) The handler only runs if 'charge.refunded' is enabled on the Stripe webhook endpoint in the dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: ow_track_invite in localStorage is overwritten by any ?for= value, including unknown slugs (e.g. ?for=e1test-doesnotexist replaces a valid invite). It is never cleared, even after sign-in. If an admin opens a prospect's personal link to preview it, all of that admin's later non-admin browsing on that device is attributed to the prospect, and it fires the 'just opened their link' alert email.

issues: The brand switcher label is cut off ('E1 Test Brand Co · contract')

action_items: Optional: stop ?for= from overwriting a valid stored invite with an unknown slug. Consider skipping tracking/attribution when the signed-in user is an admin, so admin previews don't pollute prospect timelines or trigger alert emails.

Optional: make the charge.refunded reversal atomic, e.g. a conditional UPDATE on credit_refunds or a transaction, or dedupe by event.id. Return 500 on DB failure so Stripe retries. Confirm charge.refunded is enabled on the live Stripe webhook endpoint.
Optional: group server-side 'asked Owen' events into the visitor's session (pass the client sessionId to demo.askOwen).
critical_code_review_comments: client/src/pages/AdminContacts.tsx is 4091 lines; it should be split.
track.ts relies only on visibilitychange for the final flush (keepalive fetch). This worked in testing: events from before a full navigation arrived.
isOrientationQuestion runs before the rate limit and the LLM call, so welcome answers cost no quota. In the demo askOwen path, an orientation question still uses one of the visitor's 3 demo asks.
